name: The Horizon Villa
blurb: A modern villa that blends natural surroundings with minimal architecture.
body:
A modern villa that blends natural surroundings with minimal architecture.

The brief for The Horizon Villa asked for a residential project that responds to its setting in Lake Como, Italy. We planned it around light, views and everyday movement, then built it with our own crews.

Materials were chosen to age well on site, and the same team stayed with the project from first sketch to handover in 2025.
